title: Salvaging and reprocessing.
bodyText: Wholesale distributors shall be subject to the provisions of 21 Code of Federal Regulations Parts 207, 210, and 211, regarding salvaging and reprocessing of prescription drugs.
bodyHtml: [§328-123]  Salvaging and reprocessing.  Wholesale distributors shall be subject to the provisions of 21 Code of Federal Regulations Parts 207, 210, and 211, regarding salvaging and reprocessing of prescription drugs. [L 1992, c 196, pt of §2]
